calibrated_rules.same_page: URL>=3, or URL=2 with domains>=2 inside the same intent/head term
calibrated_rules.same_cluster: URL>=1 or domains>=2 inside the same intent group
calibrated_rules.separate: 0/0 -> separate SERP; merged only as a SECTION when justified by capacity, and flagged split_candidate

methodology.why_calibrated: Italian long-tail SERPs are highly fragmented (many small studios/imprese with near-identical pages); the canonical 4-6 / 7-10 thresholds never fire in this dataset (max observed = 3). Rules were scaled down and domain overlap used as the documented tiebreaker for the ambiguous range.

excluded_keywords.reason: SERP = Indeed jobs, starchitects (Boeri, Park), directories. No Milano office -> a city page would be a doorway. Mention Milano in areaServed/service copy only.
Milano studios with local offices + directories; only 2 Milano projects. Revisit only with a real Milano presence/GBP.
Directories + MB studios; Ordine MB registration is a trust signal (Chi sono), not a page target.
Publisher/fiscal SERP (Velux, BibLus, commercialisti); YMYL and time-sensitive. Short box inside cost guides only.
Inspiration SERP (Houzz, CasaFacile) -> served by /progetti case studies, not a post.
